_meta.description: ConfidentialNotesMenu: the vertrouwenspersoon's own notes. Gated on user.isConfidentialCounsellor (group membership), not on primaryRole, so a teacher who is also the vertrouwenspersoon sees it next to the teacher menus. Access to the rows is enforced by ConfidentialNote.authorization in the register; this gate only hides the entry from everyone else.

config._note: confidential-counsellor-channel: a vertrouwenspersoon's case note. Data only, full width: no related panel (the schema references nothing and nothing references it), no email, calendar or files leaves. Sidebar keeps metadata and history.
